question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and military apparatus through repeated elite purges, including recent investigations targeting even longtime allies in the Central Military Commission. Preparations for the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027 focus on his expected continuation for a fourth term, with no verified indications of imminent removal or health-related incapacity as of mid-2026. Trader consensus at 95.3% for "No" reflects this entrenched position and the short remaining window before the December 31, 2026, market resolution date. Realistic factors that could still shift outcomes include an abrupt leadership crisis from undisclosed health developments or an unforeseen elite coalition forming against him, though both remain low-probability given current institutional consolidation.
